# RC Runtime (RahulChaube Runtime)

Rahul Chaube’s MIT-licensed JavaScript and TypeScript runtime. The native Go host embeds QuickJS-NG and esbuild. Its executable is rc. RC Web, the test library and filesystem helpers are built in. The TypeScript scaffold includes editor declarations.

- Repository: https://github.com/Rahulchaube1/rahulchaube-runtime
- Install: https://www.rahulchaube.space/download
- Commands: https://www.rahulchaube.space/cli.json
- RC Web: https://www.rahulchaube.space/docs/rc-web
- Compatibility: https://www.rahulchaube.space/docs/compatibility
- Benchmarks and methodology: https://www.rahulchaube.space/benchmarks
- Machine-readable results: https://www.rahulchaube.space/benchmarks.json
- Current release and digests: https://www.rahulchaube.space/api/version
